items.name: Micro Toastie Maker
items.longDescription: I've already bought myself a micro toastie maker for £19 - it was a bargain! Contributions towards the cost are welcome.

items.name: Contribution to a new television
items.shortDescription: Our TV could do with an upgrade (~£200 total)
items.longDescription: We're thinking about getting a new television. It would cost about £200. Any contributions towards this would be gratefully received!

items.name: Warm tracksuit (sweatshirt material)
items.shortDescription: Cosy loungewear for relaxing at home
items.longDescription: Looking for a warm tracksuit in soft sweatshirt material. No tight ankle cuffs please - I don't like them! Sweatshirt style preferred. Darker colours preferred. The key thing is it needs to be warm and soft.

items.name: Cosy jumpers
items.shortDescription: Simple, warm jumpers in various necklines
items.longDescription: Looking for straightforward, warm jumpers - nothing fancy or fussy. I don't like roll necks, but boat necks, v-necks, and round necks are all fine. Square shoulders look good too. Please nothing with a seam from armpit to the neck. Just simple and cosy!

items.name: Nice gluten-free eating/cake experience
items.shortDescription: A GF meal out, food delivery, or treats
items.longDescription: Whether it's a voucher for a restaurant with good gluten-free options, or some quality GF food or cake to enjoy at home - a nice gluten-free eating experience would be lovely. Jen loves Gluten Free Kitchen Stockport - get them to send her something!

items.name: Money towards massages
items.shortDescription: To help with baby-carrying muscle tension
items.longDescription: Carrying and caring for a growing baby puts a lot of strain on shoulders, back, and arms. Massages help manage this physical stress and provide some relaxation time. Contributions towards professional massage sessions would be greatly appreciated.

items.name: House plant pots
items.shortDescription: So I can put plants I already have, in pots in the house
items.longDescription: I already have some pleasing plants, and one things preventing me from displaying them in my home is lack of plant pots. Perhaps you can help?

items.name: Glass food storage containers with lids
items.shortDescription: CHUNGG Glass Prep Containers - set of 10
items.longDescription: Glass meal prep containers with lids, suitable for microwave, oven, fridge and dishwasher. Set of 10 in 1040ML & 370ML sizes.

items.name: Time with helpers for sorting/organizing
items.shortDescription: To help sort out things around the house
items.longDescription: I'd benefit from helpful people to work with me on doing things round the house one day when James is at nursery and I'm off work.

items.name: Krupnik Plum Liquor (500ml)
items.shortDescription: My preferred liquor with a pleasing taste
items.longDescription: Available from Food Plus (£12.89) or Polish shops. 30% ABV, 500ml bottles. The more bottles the better! A refined recipe combining delicate sweetness of plums with a gentle alcohol warmth.
